name: readonly-command-activity-write
title: Make append-nothing commands actually append nothing, or correct the guarantee they advertise
description: A command documented as writing NOTHING writes an activity-log row. packages/main/src/cli/activity-policy.ts:23-25 states an append-nothing classification; red_evidence_envelope_check nonetheless appends to .lattice/activity.jsonl, because cli-engine.ts writeLog is gated on a predicate that does not agree with that classification. Deferred from B-9ff1 as F-014 and given a real home after B-9ff1:F-064 established the claimed follow-up did not exist.
source: B-9ff1:F-014 (empirical, post-merge); homed after B-9ff1:F-064 found no follow-up artifact existed
